body:
After trying a load of the 'commercial' reschems that contain often unknown mixtures, I had read a few things (good and bad) about Ethylphenidate, and it had me intrigued.
I got 0.5g delivered for £8.
After reading reports of its burning and painfulness from insufflation, I crumbled it down in to an approx 20mg line. Up it goes. Slight eye watering and burning sensation, that quickly went.
Nothing felt, twenty mins later, Approx 50mg line. Snort! I start feeling something. Feeling pretty good, not distracted by it, just felt quite good, slight heart rate increase.
Another 50mg line 20 mins later. Stronger, heart going faster, feels a little familiar. For the 'tiny' amounts I've done I've felt FAR more than I have done in the past from a whole g of 'street stuff'.
Beyond this I did roughly 50-80mg lines till it was all gone. Very potent.
Didnt sleep a wink all night (I started around 4pm, stopped around 1:30am, very VERY horny around an hour later, for a few hours!). Other than sleep deprivation have felt okay today.
Not sure if I will do again though. It does burn a lot initially, and have had a lot of blood from blowing my nose, also experienced coughing up what looks like white gum in little segments!
I feel the closest to the real thing that I have experienced.
